name: D2CollectsIncidentDate
title: DHIS2 program collects an incident date
description: Whether the DHIS2 tracker program a registration form enrols a person into collects the date of the incident the enrollment follows. True means every enrollment the program creates states that date and a response to this form carries D2IncidentAt; false means the program collects none and a response carries none. Only a registration form declares it, because only a program has enrollments.
